data.gender_notes: Yorgos is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: George, Farmer, Worker of the earth
data.long_meaning: From the Greek 'georgos' meaning 'farmer' or 'earth worker'. This name is derived from the Greek god of agriculture, Gea. In Christianity, St. George is a popular saint, known for his bravery and protection. The name Yorgos carries the meaning “George, Farmer, Worker of the earth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Yorgos usually hope their child will grow to embody george, farmer, worker of the earth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Yorgos is a name with deep spiritual roots, connected to the earth and the divine. It is a reminder of the importance of nurturing and caring for the world around us, and the power that comes from working in harmony with the natural world.
data.etymology: Yorgos belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “George, Farmer, Worker of the earth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yorgos total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
